name: generic
description: Any subject: the checkable or actionable claims a creator makes.
card_is: a claim someone could act on or check: a rule, a technique, a recommendation, a prediction, or a comparison. Background facts, anecdotes and motivation are not cards.

fields.name: topic
fields.description: the subject the claim is about, in two or three words

fields.name: when
fields.description: the situation or condition in which it applies, as stated

fields.name: expect
fields.description: the result the creator says follows

fields.name: caveats
fields.description: limits or exceptions the creator gives
